welcome.title: Welcome · 关系、挑战与未来表达

words.translation: 同甘共苦 / 风雨同舟
words.definition: in spite of all problems, difficulties, or bad conditions
words.example: True friends stick together through thick and thin.
words.exampleTranslation: 真正的朋友无论顺境逆境都会同舟共济、患难与共。
words.kronTip: 穿越灌木密林与平坦开阔地，比喻不离不弃经历一切艰难险阻！

transfer.q: 'through thick and thin' 最贴切的中文含义是？
options: 同甘共苦 / 风雨同舟
粗心大意 / 敷衍了事
若即若离 / 虚情假意
急功近利 / 见异思迁
transfer.exp: 太棒了！through thick and thin 意为无论面对何种艰难坎坷都患难与共。

words.translation: 起起落落 / 人生波折坎坷
words.definition: a mixture of good and bad things in life or a relationship
words.example: Life is full of ups and downs, but perseverance always pays off.
words.exampleTranslation: 人生充满起起伏伏，但坚韧不拔终将迎来回报。
words.kronTip: 人生的高峰与低谷交替出现，强调生活与事业的常态律动！

transfer.q: 生活中的 'ups and downs' 指的是？
transfer.exp: 正确！ups and downs 指生活或事业中的起起落落、波折起伏。

words.translation: 泄露秘密 / 走漏风声
words.definition: to tell people secret information, especially unintentionally
words.example: We were planning a surprise party, but someone spilled the beans.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们原本在筹备惊喜派对，但有人走漏了风声提前泄密了。
words.kronTip: 古希腊投票用黑白豆，坛子打翻豆子滚落就公开了秘密！

transfer.q: 'spill the beans' 形象地表示什么？
options: 泄露秘密 / 走漏风声
transfer.exp: 完全正确！spill the beans 极为生动地表示不慎透露了保密事项。

words.translation: 拐弯抹角 / 兜圈子
words.definition: to avoid talking about what is important
words.example: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what really happened.
words.exampleTranslation: 别再拐弯抹角了，直接告诉我究竟发生了什么。
words.kronTip: 猎人打草惊蛇只敲灌木外围而不抓核心，比喻言不及义绕圈子！

transfer.q: 对方说话时如果你希望他直奔主题，你可以说：
transfer.exp: 太棒了！Stop beating around the bush 意为别再拐弯抹角、快直说吧。

phrases.translation: 看法完全一致 / 英雄所见略同
phrases.definition: to agree with someone completely
phrases.example: My business partner and I see eye to eye on almost every major strategy.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 我和商业合伙人在几乎每项重大战略上都英雄所见略同、看法完全一致。
phrases.kronTip: 目光平视相对，形容两人志趣相投、观点高度一致！

transfer.q: 'see eye to eye' 表示：
transfer.exp: 正确！see eye to eye with sb 意为与某人意见完全契合。

phrases.translation: 结识新友 / 建立友谊
phrases.definition: to start a friendly relationship with someone
phrases.example: It didn't take long for the two scholars to strike up a lifelong friendship.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 两位学者没过多久就建立起了一段相伴一生的深厚学术友谊。
phrases.kronTip: strike up 如同擦亮火花般迅速开启一段美好的交谊！

transfer.q: 与新同学快速建立友谊，英文高阶搭配是：
transfer.exp: 太棒了！strike up a friendship/conversation 开启一段友谊或对话。

phrases.translation: 带来积极改变 / 产生深远影响
phrases.definition: to have a significant and positive effect on something
phrases.example: Even small sustainable actions can make a huge difference to our planet.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 哪怕是微小的可持续日常行动，也能为我们的地球带来巨大的积极改变。
phrases.kronTip: 使事物产生差异性变化，强调积极深远的建设性影响！

transfer.q: 'make a difference' 强调的是：
options: 产生有意义的积极改变
transfer.exp: 完全正确！make a difference 意为产生显著的积极正面影响。

sentences.text: True friends stick together through thick and thin.
sentences.translation: 真正的朋友无论顺境逆境都会同舟共济、患难与共。
sentences.kronTip: through thick and thin，风雨同舟患难与共的高阶写作范句！

transfer.q: 句子 'True friends stick together through thick and thin.' 的准确含义是？
options: 真正的朋友无论顺境逆境都会同舟共济、患难与共。
朋友之间应该有福同享，有难各自飞奔。
身材胖瘦不同的朋友也能成为好伙伴。
在茂密的森林里朋友们走散了。
transfer.exp: 太棒了！原句表达无论处于何种困难逆境都患难与共。

sentences.text: Life is full of ups and downs, but perseverance always pays off.
sentences.translation: 人生充满起起伏伏，但坚韧不拔终将迎来回报。
sentences.kronTip: ups and downs 搭配 pay off (得到回报)，经典励志复合句！

transfer.q: 'perseverance always pays off' 意为？
options: 坚持不懈终将迎来回报
transfer.exp: 正确！perseverance 意为坚持不懈，pays off 意为获得圆满报偿。

sentences.text: There is no point in beating around the bush; let's get straight to the point.
sentences.translation: 拐弯抹角毫无意义，让我们直奔主题吧。
sentences.kronTip: There is no point in doing... 句型表示'做某事毫无益处'！

sentences.text: Don't be afraid to speak your mind and challenge conventional wisdom.
sentences.translation: 不要害怕畅所欲言，勇于质疑陈规俗套。
sentences.kronTip: speak your mind 直抒胸臆，conventional wisdom 传统惯常认知！

words.translation: 传统的 / 守旧的
words.definition: following the customs or ways of behaving that have continued in a group of people or society for a long time
words.example: As a result, eldest children tend to be respectful and traditional.
words.exampleTranslation: 因此，长子长女往往既懂规矩又较恪守传统。
words.kronTip: 词根 trad- (传递) + -al (形容词后缀) = 代代相传的！

transfer.q: 'traditional' 在 C1 语境中的最贴切中文含义是？
transfer.exp: 太棒了！'traditional' 的核心含义正是 '传统的 / 守旧的'。记忆技巧：词根 trad- (传递) + -al (形容词后缀) = 代代相传的！...

words.translation: 缺乏安全感的 / 不自信的
words.definition: having no confidence in yourself and what you can do
words.example: As a consequence, the first-born feels insecure.
words.exampleTranslation: 结果，第一个出生的孩子常会感到缺乏安全感。
words.kronTip: in- (否定前缀) + secure (安心踏实的) = 忐忑不安、缺乏自信！

transfer.q: 'insecure' 在 C1 语境中的最贴切中文含义是？
options: 缺乏安全感的 / 不自信的
transfer.exp: 太棒了！'insecure' 的核心含义正是 '缺乏安全感的 / 不自信的'。记忆技巧：in- (否定前缀) + secure (安心踏实的) = 忐忑不安、缺乏自信！...

words.translation: 不落俗套的 / 标新立异的
words.definition: doing things in a way that is different from most people
words.example: The second child tends to be more unconventional and rebellious.
words.exampleTranslation: 家里的老二往往更加不落窠臼且生性反叛。
words.kronTip: un- (非) + conventional (传统的)，指行事打破常规！

transfer.q: 'unconventional' 在 C1 语境中的最贴切中文含义是？
options: 不落俗套的 / 标新立异的
transfer.exp: 太棒了！'unconventional' 的核心含义正是 '不落俗套的 / 标新立异的'。记忆技巧：un- (非) + conventional (传统的)，指行事打破常规！...

words.translation: 苛求的 / 费心劳力的
words.definition: needing a lot of time, attention, or energy
words.example: Their newest offspring may well be more demanding.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们刚出生的小宝宝可能会耗费父母更多的精力与照看。
words.kronTip: demand (要求) 的分词转化形容词，指要求极高、令人筋疲力尽！

transfer.q: 'demanding' 在 C1 语境中的最贴切中文含义是？
options: 苛求的 / 费心劳力的
transfer.exp: 太棒了！'demanding' 的核心含义正是 '苛求的 / 费心劳力的'。记忆技巧：demand (要求) 的分词转化形容词，指要求极高、令人筋疲力尽！...

phrases.example: It was only a joke. There’s no need to get so hot under the collar about it.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 那不过是一句无心的玩笑，你完全没必要为此气急败坏、大动肝火。

phrases.translation: 对某人冷眼相待 / 冷落某人
phrases.definition: to intentionally ignore someone or treat someone in an unfriendly way

phrases.exampleTranslation: 自从那次意见不合吵架之后，她整整一周都对我冷眼相待、视若无睹。
phrases.kronTip: 英国古老风俗：贵客招待热羊腿，讨厌的客人给冷硬羊肩肉！

words.translation: 特技动作 / 惊险表演
words.definition: an exciting action, usually in a film, that is dangerous or appears dangerous and usually needs to be done by someone skilled
words.example: He completed a remarkable stunt when he somersaulted from one glider to another at 160 kmph.
words.exampleTranslation: 许多好莱坞动作巨星坚持不用替身，亲自完成高难度危险特技。

words.translation: 发音 / 读音
words.definition: to say a word or a letter in a particular way
words.example: I do my best to pronounce things clearly.
words.exampleTranslation: 初学英语的学生经常难以准确发出'th'字母组合的轻辅音 /θ/。

words.translation: 母语使用者 / 操本族语者
words.definition: someone who has spoken a particular language since they were a baby, rather than having learned it as a child or adult
words.example: I'm not a native speaker so people often misunderstand me.
words.exampleTranslation: 跟母语为英语的人多进行即兴日常对话，是快速建立语感的捷径。
words.kronTip: native (生而具备的/本地的) + speaker (说话者)！

words.translation: 误解 / 误会
words.definition: to think you have understood someone or something when you have not
words.example: I'm not a native speaker so people often misunderstand me.
words.exampleTranslation: 幽默如果缺乏恰当的文化语境铺垫，极其容易被外国听众误解。

words.translation: 浓重的口音 / 乡音
words.definition: the way in which people in a particular area, country, or social group pronounce words
words.example: The other day I met someone from another part of the country who had such a strong accent.
words.exampleTranslation: 尽管在伦敦居住了三十年，老教授依然带着一股辨识度极高的苏格兰浓重口音。
words.kronTip: accent 指地域或母语带来的发音特色；区别于 dialect (包含语法词汇的方言)！

transfer.q: 'strong accent' 在 C1 语境中的最贴切中文含义是？

words.translation: 第一语言 / 母语
words.definition: the language that someone learns to speak first
words.example: It was hard to believe that we shared the same first language.
words.exampleTranslation: 在双语家庭中长大的孩子，往往能够把两种不同语系的语言都掌握为第一母语。

words.translation: 难以理解的 / 晦涩难懂的

words.translation: 方言 / 地方土语
words.definition: a form of a language that people speak in a particular part of a country, containing some different words and grammar, etc.

transfer.q: 'dialect' 在 C1 语境中的最贴切中文含义是？

words.translation: 跟上思路 / 听懂
words.definition: to understand something as it is being said or done
words.example: He was using slang words which meant I just couldn't follow him.
words.exampleTranslation: 演讲者的语速实在太快了，以至于后排的听众很难全程跟上他的逻辑思路。
words.kronTip: 口语中常问：Are you following me? 你听明白我的意思了吗？

transfer.q: 'follow' 在 C1 语境中的最贴切中文含义是？

words.translation: 口译 / 阐释解读
words.definition: to decide what the intended meaning of something is

words.exampleTranslation: 同声传译员必须在高压环境下，将发言人的观点瞬间实时口译成目标语。
words.kronTip: 区别于书面翻译 (translate)；特指口头翻译或阐释深层含义！

words.translation: 语言壁垒 / 语言隔阂

words.translation: 资本主义制度
words.definition: a political and economic system in which industry is owned privately for profit and not by the state
words.example: Under capitalism, some people can become very rich.
words.exampleTranslation: 在自由市场资本主义体制下，生产资料主要由私人企业所拥有以追求商业利润。

words.definition: the belief that bad things will happen

words.translation: 铭记在心 / 纳入考量考虑之中

words.translation: 转瞬之间 / 立刻 / 很快

phrases.translation: 投票赞成支持某人

phrases.exampleTranslation: 在全国瞩目的大选中，这位年轻有为的政治家以绝对优势票数当选为新任国家总理。

transfer.exp: 太棒了！'be recognised as' 的核心含义正是 '被公认为 / 获得业界权威认证'。记忆技巧：recognise (承认/赏识)；其权威成就获得同行或全社会的普遍推崇！...

phrases.translation: 成功办成(艰难奇迹) / 漂亮拿下
phrases.definition: to succeed in doing something difficult or unexpected
phrases.example: My team wasn't playing well, but they still managed to pull off a last minute victory.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 面对几乎不可能逆转的终局，教练与全队精诚合作，漂亮地完成了一场载入史册的惊天大逆转。
phrases.kronTip: 地道动词短语，指在困难重重、众人不看好的情况下硬是创造了奇迹！

phrases.translation: 战胜逆境 / 迎难而上战胜厄运
phrases.definition: to succeed in a difficult or unlucky situation or event
phrases.example: Readers often feel inspired by people who manage to overcome adversity.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 真正的英雄主义不在于从未跌入谷底，而在于跌入谷底后依然能够昂首挺胸战胜重重厄运逆境。

phrases.translation: 追逐心中的梦想 / 勇往直前
phrases.definition: If you pursue a dream, you try to do it or achieve it, usually over a long period of time
phrases.example: If you really want to pursue your dreams, you mustn't waste any time and you have to study hard.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 不要让世俗的偏见禁锢你的脚步，勇敢地去追逐你内心真正深爱的人生梦想吧。
phrases.kronTip: pursue 带着坚定与毅力持续不断地追索与追求！

phrases.translation: 遭遇惨烈失败 / 轰轰烈烈跌入低谷
phrases.definition: to be completely unsuccessful in an attempt
phrases.example: It's ironic that he believed he was the best and then failed spectacularly.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 那次看似准备周全的火箭首次发射遭遇了惨痛失利，但工程师们从碎片中汲取了无价的教训。
phrases.kronTip: spectacularly 引人注目地、壮观地；指在聚光灯下轰轰烈烈地败下阵来！

phrases.translation: 向现实妥协放弃梦想
phrases.definition: to expect someone or something to fail
phrases.example: When he learnt about his illness, he wasn't prepared to give up on his dreams.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 哪怕经历再多的挫折与外界嘲弄，他也绝不轻言向现实认输、丢弃自己的戏剧梦想。

phrases.translation: 处于公众视线聚焦之下 / 备受社会瞩目
phrases.definition: to be famous and written about in newspapers and magazines and seen on television
phrases.example: We're looking for normal everyday people who aren't in the public eye.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 作为长期生活在公众视线显微镜下的人物，公众人物的一言一行都会被无限放大与审视。
phrases.kronTip: 曝光在千百万双社会公众眼睛的注视聚焦之中！

phrases.translation: 尽管…… / 不顾……艰险阻碍
phrases.definition: even though there is something unpleasant or bad happening
phrases.example: It's the story of a young man who achieved remarkable things in spite of a very difficult life.
phrases.exampleTranslation: 尽管路途艰险且遭遇了狂风暴雨的无情阻挠，救援科考车队依然准时抵达了震中大营。
phrases.kronTip: 相当于 despite，后接名词、代词或动名词短语，表示强转折让步！
